# Painted chair skin

Generated using the built-in image-generation tool on October 9, 2026. Copied unchanged into the project; the asset does not depend on the generator's output folder.

## Final prompt

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production texture atlas for four simple low-poly chairs in Animal Factory Tactics.
Create one opaque square bitmap, a precisely aligned 4 by 4 grid of SIXTEEN FLAT square material panels. Each row exactly one quarter of image height; each column exactly one quarter image width. No margin, no gutters, no outside background. All panels viewed straight on, no perspective views of furniture, no drawings of complete chairs. Geometry supplies the silhouette; this atlas supplies rich hand-painted detail.
Style: bright readable painterly late-1990s tactical game assets. Confident brush strokes, broad warm highlights, graphic dark seams, modest wear. Hand-painted illustration, not photorealism, not flat vector. Avoid muddy materials, noisy grunge, logos and readable text.
Row 1, left to right: (1) warm russet-red leather wingback BACK cushion with three subtle tufted vertical channels, dark perimeter piping and softly painted buttons, flat rectangular panel; (2) matching russet leather SEAT cushion with broad clean worn highlight in center, perimeter stitched seam, no buttons; (3) matching plain russet leather side/arm material with fine brush grain and no tufting; (4) dark walnut wood plain grain swatch for legs, vertical grain.
Row 2 left to right: (1) honey-colored wooden SEAT panel, three broad boards with shallow painted joints running vertically; (2) honey wood BACK panel, restrained grain, lightly worn rounded perimeter painted in, no cutout holes; (3) honey wood plain timber swatch with vertical grain, warm highlighted center and darker edges; (4) darker end-grain wood swatch, broad brush treatment.
Row 3 left to right: (1) muted sage-green painted steel SEAT panel, broad center wear highlight, perimeter dark seam and four subtle painted fasteners near corners; (2) matching sage-green BACK panel, three long recessed vertical stamped ribs expressed only in painted highlights/shadows, no actual holes; (3) plain sage-green painted steel swatch for frame, subtle edge chips, most surface remains paint; (4) charcoal iron swatch for tubular feet and joints, soft painted highlights.
Row 4 left to right: (1) dark petrol-teal padded desk-chair BACK panel with a perimeter stitched seam and two broad vertical cushion channels; (2) matching teal SEAT cushion with warm desaturated highlights and dark stitched perimeter; (3) matching plain teal upholstery side swatch; (4) dark charcoal rubber/bakelite swatch with broad painterly highlights for caster wheels.
Keep high contrast between useful features while each panel remains coherent and clear at thumbnail size. No cast shadows outside panels. No transparency. Exactly these sixteen flat painted materials.
